purpose: Version2 canonical catalog query recipes; table queries are generated from snapshot inventory. No source rows.
hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of PostgreSQL COPY FORMAT text bytes after ordering canonical text with COLLATE C
databaseMetadataJsonQuery:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'name', d.datname, 'owner', pg_get_userbyid(d.datdba), 'encoding', pg_encoding_to_char(d.encoding),
  'collate', d.datcollate, 'ctype', d.datctype, 'localeProvider', d.datlocprovider,
  'locale', d.datlocale, 'icuRules', d.daticurules, 'collationVersion', d.datcollversion,
  'connectionLimit', d.datconnlimit,
  'isTemplate', d.datistemplate, 'allowConnections', d.datallowconn,
  'comment', obj_description(d.oid, 'pg_database'),
  'acl', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'grantor', pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor), 'grantee', CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
    'privilege', a.privilege_type, 'grantable', a.is_grantable)
    ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) COLLATE "C", CASE WHEN a.grantee = 0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END COLLATE "C", a.privilege_type COLLATE "C")
    FROM aclexplode(d.datacl) a), '[]'::jsonb),
  'databaseRoleSettings', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'role', CASE WHEN s.setrole = 0 THEN 'ALL' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(s.setrole) END,
    'settings', to_jsonb(s.setconfig)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.setrole = 0 THEN 'ALL' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(s.setrole) END COLLATE "C")
    FROM pg_db_role_setting s WHERE s.setdatabase = d.oid), '[]'::jsonb)
)::text FROM pg_database d WHERE d.datname = current_database()
extensionInventoryJsonQuery:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(canonical::jsonb ORDER BY canonical COLLATE "C"), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'name', e.extname, 'version', e.extversion, 'owner', pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner),
      'schema', n.nspname, 'relocatable', e.extrelocatable,
      'config', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'schema', cn.nspname, 'relation', cc.relname, 'condition', config.condition)
        ORDER BY cn.nspname COLLATE "C", cc.relname COLLATE "C")
        FROM unnest(e.extconfig, e.extcondition) AS config(relid, condition)
        JOIN pg_class cc ON cc.oid=config.relid JOIN pg_namespace cn ON cn.oid=cc.relnamespace), '[]'::jsonb),
      'members', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'type', identified.type, 'schema', identified.schema, 'name', identified.name, 'identity', identified.identity)
        ORDER BY identified.type COLLATE "C", coalesce(identified.schema,'') COLLATE "C", coalesce(identified.name,'') COLLATE "C", identified.identity COLLATE "C")
        FROM pg_depend d
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_identify_object(d.classid, d.objid, d.objsubid) identified
        WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.refobjid=e.oid AND d.deptype='e'), '[]'::jsonb)
    )::text AS canonical
    FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace) extension_rows

metadataRowQueries.extensions:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'name', e.extname, 'version', e.extversion, 'owner', pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner),
      'schema', n.nspname, 'relocatable', e.extrelocatable,
      'config', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'schema', cn.nspname, 'relation', cc.relname, 'condition', config.condition)
        ORDER BY cn.nspname COLLATE "C", cc.relname COLLATE "C")
        FROM unnest(e.extconfig, e.extcondition) AS config(relid, condition)
        JOIN pg_class cc ON cc.oid=config.relid JOIN pg_namespace cn ON cn.oid=cc.relnamespace), '[]'::jsonb),
      'members', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'type', identified.type, 'schema', identified.schema, 'name', identified.name, 'identity', identified.identity)
        ORDER BY identified.type COLLATE "C", coalesce(identified.schema,'') COLLATE "C", coalesce(identified.name,'') COLLATE "C", identified.identity COLLATE "C")
        FROM pg_depend d
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL pg_identify_object(d.classid, d.objid, d.objsubid) identified
        WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.refobjid=e.oid AND d.deptype='e'), '[]'::jsonb)
    )::text AS canonical
    FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace
metadataRowQueries.schemas:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema', n.nspname, 'owner', pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),
      'acl', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor', pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
      'grantee', CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
      'privilege', a.privilege_type, 'grantable', a.is_grantable)
      ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) COLLATE "C", CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END COLLATE "C", a.privilege_type COLLATE "C")
      FROM aclexplode(n.nspacl) a), '[]'::jsonb))::text AS canonical
      FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
metadataRowQueries.functions:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema', n.nspname, 'name', p.proname,
      'identityArguments', pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), 'result', pg_get_function_result(p.oid),
      'language', l.lanname, 'kind', p.prokind,
      'definitionKind', CASE WHEN p.prokind='a' THEN 'aggregate-catalog-only' ELSE 'pg_get_functiondef' END,
      'securityDefiner', p.prosecdef,
      'volatility', p.provolatile, 'strict', p.proisstrict, 'parallel', p.proparallel,
      'owner', pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner), 'definition', CASE WHEN p.prokind IN ('f','p','w') THEN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) ELSE NULL END)::text AS canonical
      FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
      WHERE n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
metadataRowQueries.rowLevelSecurity:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema', n.nspname, 'table', c.relname,
      'rlsEnabled', c.relrowsecurity, 'rlsForced', c.relforcerowsecurity,
      'policies', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'policy', p.polname, 'permissive', p.polpermissive, 'command', p.polcmd,
        'roles', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END ORDER BY CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END COLLATE "C") FROM unnest(p.polroles) r), '[]'::jsonb),
        'using', pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid), 'withCheck', pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid))
        ORDER BY p.polname COLLATE "C") FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid=c.oid), '[]'::jsonb))::text AS canonical
      FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
      WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
metadataRowQueries.grants:
SELECT canonical FROM (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind','schema','schema',n.nspname,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
        'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
        'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable)::text canonical
      FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(n.nspacl) a WHERE n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind',c.relkind::text,'schema',n.nspname,'object',c.relname,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
        'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
        'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable)::text
      FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) a
      WHERE n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind','function','schema',n.nspname,'object',p.proname,
        'identityArguments',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
        'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
        'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable)::text
      FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(p.proacl) a
      WHERE n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind','defaultAcl','role',pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),'schema',coalesce(n.nspname,''),
        'objectType',d.defaclobjtype,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
        'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
        'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable)::text
      FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) a
    ) grant_rows
metadataRowQueries.sequences:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),
      'dataType',format_type(s.seqtypid,NULL),'start',s.seqstart::text,'increment',s.seqincrement::text,
      'minimum',s.seqmin::text,'maximum',s.seqmax::text,'cache',s.seqcache::text,'cycle',s.seqcycle)::text AS canonical
      FROM pg_sequence s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=s.seqrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
      WHERE n.nspname !~ '^pg_' AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema'

largeObjectRowQuery:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('oid', m.oid::text, 'owner', pg_get_userbyid(m.lomowner),
      'acl', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),
      'grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,
      'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable)
      ORDER BY pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) COLLATE "C", CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END COLLATE "C", a.privilege_type COLLATE "C")
      FROM aclexplode(m.lomacl) a),'[]'::jsonb),
      'pages', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('page',l.pageno,'hex',encode(l.data,'hex')) ORDER BY l.pageno)
      FROM pg_largeobject l WHERE l.loid=m.oid),'[]'::jsonb))::text AS canonical FROM pg_largeobject_metadata m
